parameters.name: EventTime
parameters.description: Indicates the date and time when the alarm event occurs.

parameters.name: AlarmIdentifier
parameters.description: Identifies one Alarm Entry in the Alarm List. This value MUST be uniquely allocated by the device to the alarm instance during the lifetime of the individual alarm.

parameters.name: NotificationType
parameters.description: Indicates the reason for the specific alarm notification event. {{enum}}

parameters.name: ManagedObjectInstance
parameters.description: Specifies the instance of the Informational Object Class in which the alarm occurred by carrying the Distinguished Name (DN) of this object instance. The format of the DN is specific to the application that is using this {{object}}.

parameters.name: ProbableCause
parameters.description: Qualifies the alarm and provides further information than {{param|EventType}}.

parameters.name: SpecificProblem
parameters.description: Provides further qualification on the alarm beyond {{param|EventType}} and {{param|ProbableCause}}. This is vendor defined and will be {{empty}} if the device doesn't support inclusion of this information.

parameters.name: PerceivedSeverity
parameters.description: Indicates the relative level of urgency for operator attention, see {{bibref|ITU-X.733}}. {{enum}}

parameters.name: AdditionalText
parameters.description: This provides a textual string which is vendor defined. This will be {{empty}} if the device doesn't support inclusion of this information.

parameters.name: AdditionalInformation
parameters.description: This contains additional information about the alarm and is vendor defined.

object.description: Alarm events added or updated in {{object|#.CurrentAlarm}} are simultaneously entered into the this table. This table also contains alarm clearing events. Active alarms at the time of a power failure or reboot might not get an alarm clearing event. This object has a fixed number of entries with instance numbers from 1 to {{param|#.HistoryEventNumberOfEntries}}. If maximum instance number {{param|#.HistoryEventNumberOfEntries}} is reached, the next event overrides the object with instance number 1. Subsequent entries override objects at sequentially increasing instance numbers. This logic provides for automatic "rolling" of records.
